title: Agents avoiding each other (RVO2 / ORCA)
description: RVO2 computes reciprocal collision avoidance for twelve agents crossing a circle. Paths show their actual simulated positions with a minimum-separation check. A small tangential preference breaks perfect symmetry.
description_ko: RVO2로 원을 가로지르는 에이전트 12개의 상호 충돌 회피를 계산했어요. 최소 거리를 검사한 실제 이동 경로예요. 작은 접선 방향 선호로 완전한 대칭 정체를 피했어요.
prompt: Agents avoiding each other. Rerun the included recipe to change inputs.
made_with: Original native source at a pinned commit; C/C++ compilation executed locally on macOS arm64
